_note: AUTHORED-NOT-RUN (see OBL-001 _note). CLAIM-B + DURABLE DUTY (docs/obligation-examples.md §1): a supervisory AGENT's assessment activates an independent-human-review obligation; an independent human reviewer satisfies it; deadline expiry escalates. Role==actor_id: agent actor id 'supervisoryAgent' (type agent) triggers; human actor id 'reviewer' (type human) satisfies (role 'reviewer', notSameAsTriggerActor honored since trigger was the agent). activateWhen uses actor.actorType:'agent' and satisfyWhen actor.actorType:'human' — resolve_actor_kind reads each actor's declared 'type', so the agent/human kinds must be declared in actors[]. This fixture pins the ACTIVATE->SATISFY path. The EXPIRY->ESCALATE alternative (onViolation:escalate -> ObligationExpired+ObligationViolated with effectiveAction:'escalate', plus a rerouted 'supervisor' escalation event) needs a sibling fixture/harness run with a delay > P1D; authored here only as a note. Also confirm whether an agent-type actor requires an agents[] block under schema/lint — the conformance engine deserializes KernelDocument (no full JSON-schema gate), so it runs without one, but a schema-faithful variant may need agents[].
